articles.title_hinglish: CtrlS 150 megavata deta sentara sthapita karane ke lie 10,000 karoda rupaye ka nivesha karega
articles.summary_hinglish: CtrlS detasentarsa ne 150 megavata AI suvidha banane ke lie 10,000 karoda rupaye ke nivesha ki ghoshana ki hai। isa suvidha ka lakshya bihara men varsha 2029-30 taka vanijyika parichalana shuru karana hai। isa nivesha ko suvidhajanaka banane ke lie bihara sarakara ke satha emaoyu para hastakshara kiye gaye hain. prastavita deta sentara samaya ke satha kshetra men 400 pratyaksha naukariyan paida karega।

articles.title: Muslim Student Assaulted in Canada in Suspected Hate Crime
articles.summary: An Iranian student at Western University in Ontario was physically assaulted by two men who yelled racist insults at him. Mohammad Sharifi suffered injuries including severe headaches following the attack at a downtown market. The National Council of Canadian Muslims condemned the violence and called for the perpetrators to face prosecution under the law.

articles.title: CtrlS Signs MoU with Bihar Government for 150-MW AI-Ready Data Centre
articles.summary: Located in the Patliputra Industrial Area, Patna, the facility will support the growing digital infrastructure needs of enterprises, government institutions, hyperscalers and technology businesses in Bihar.   The strong market potential and growing demand for digital infrastructure has reinforced CtrlS Datacenters’ confidence in Bihar, supporting the growth of Eastern India’s evolving data centre ecosystem.

articles.title: India's PNB brings in Deutsche Bank as state lenders move into takeover finance
articles.summary: It names no borrower, target or amount, commits neither side to any transaction and leaves each to take its own credit decisions, Business Today reported. State Bank of India signed a strategic partnership with Japan's MUFG Bank in March, and Bank of Baroda followed with Mizuho Bank on June 30, agreeing to originate, structure, co-underwrite and syndicate takeover loans together.
